name: CLAW: Feed Gulper
summary: Qualified browser-preview evidence exists, but this Home page withholds launch until WO-002 player integration.
description: CLAW: Feed Gulper has a qualified staging browser cartridge from the CP9/V13 donor. WO-001 intentionally does not expose a launch route until the current player shell is integrated and regression-tested in WO-002. The current Home card remains a preview surface.

web.shortDescription: Qualified staging cartridge exists; Home launch remains withheld until WO-002 player integration.
